global_prompt: A single continuous cinematic close-up in the same professional kitchen. The same chef continues finishing the plated chocolate dessert on the stainless steel counter. Lighting, camera movement, background softness, and visual continuity remain stable and realistic.
local_prompts: The chef begins to lift his head from the working position, slowly moving his gaze away from the dessert surface.
His eyes shift forward as he straightens slightly, still keeping the dessert within his field of view.
The camera subtly rises with him, maintaining a medium close-up that includes both his face and the plated dessert.
He pauses halfway upright, studying the dessert with a composed and satisfied expression.
His shoulders relax slightly as the intense precision of the plating process gives way to calm inspection.
The dessert remains centered on the counter, with the mint leaf clearly visible as the final accent.
